title: ACTIVE NEMATIC
description: Hundreds of oriented filaments exchange alignment and angular momentum with their neighbours. Local defects are born asynchronously instead of from a global clock; dragging writes a persistent twist wake into the director field and can reorganize the whole material.

visual_finish.composition: an asymmetric director field forms broad aligned rivers punctured by moving topological defect basins
visual_finish.material_model: short birefringent biological filaments with order-dependent opacity, warm defect cores and cool aligned domains
